due_when.clears_when: EITHER claude-pr-automerge no longer opens PRs (it adopts only, and says so when there is none to adopt), OR a bot-opened PR is demonstrated running its required checks after some specific action, with the run ids. [!] CORRECTING THE PROSE ALONE DOES NOT CLOSE THIS -- the trap is created by a push ORDER that is easy to get wrong under time pressure, and CLAUDE.md already warns about it in the paragraph whose remedy is wrong. [!] AND A LATER PR THAT HAPPENS TO MERGE DOES NOT CLOSE IT unless it was OPENED BY THE BOT: a PR opened by a session merges fine and proves nothing about this class.
